purpose: Exploratory pre-outcome coverage stage (exploratory protocol v1): verify free historical funding, prices, contract identity and settlement coverage for the verified overlap of >=2 venues; freeze run ID and manifest before any outcome calculation. Separately versioned from FVD-DISPERSION-V1; does not modify the frozen grid, FVD001-FVD108, FVD053, or the original run manifest.
contract_mapping_basis: underlying symbol match (BTC) only; instrument metadata cross-check / delisting lifecycle not independently verified

cost_assumptions.note: frozen grid base scenario; sensitivity assumption, not a venue fee claim

sample_construction: Verified historical intersection of instruments with funding settlements + price history on >=2 venues; no market-cap rank required for this distinct exploratory estimand; shorter history allowed; not market-cap representative.
exclusion_rules: >=30 valid prior daily observations required for threshold
data_gate_result: PARTIAL — funding and settlement verified for both venues (~33 days); price history verified OKX only (~4 days), Hyperliquid unconfirmed (422); contract identity symbol-only/unverified; actionable overlap <= ~4 days below FVD053 threshold minimum (>=30 prior daily observations)
implementation_gate_result: Source-independent primitives covered by known-answer/adversarial tests and conformance validators; real-data signal construction not exercised (sample too short)
anchor_result: Not exercised — actionable overlap <= ~4 days cannot satisfy the >=30 prior daily observation threshold; no signal episodes formed
conclusion: EXPLORATORY_ONLY / INCONCLUSIVE for inference. The exploratory sample does not pass the full data gate (price history and contract identity gaps; insufficient actionable overlap). The frozen FVD053 anchor was not exercised. No backtest, no performance metric, no economic edge claimed. Confirmatory gate BLOCKED_DATA_GATE preserved.
next_step: Per exploratory protocol section 6 stop rule: do not fabricate or substitute data; preserve confirmatory gate; proceed to a bounded source-independent task rather than retrying failed sources.
caveats: Free public sources lack >=3 years of historical point-in-time market-cap ranks with both effective/as-of and publication/availability timestamps; confirmatory gate remains BLOCKED_DATA_GATE.
CryptWatch (~13.5 years daily) lacks per-snapshot publication/availability timestamps; does not satisfy the gate.
OKX funding retention ~33 days; OKX public 1H candles ~4 days; Hyperliquid price endpoint returned 422 and is unconfirmed.
Current cap snapshots are discovery-only; no market-cap rank substituted for historical ranks in this exploratory estimand.
Modeled fees/slippage (base 5/5 bps) are sensitivity assumptions, not measured venue costs.
No performance metric or economic edge claimed; EXPLORATORY_ONLY does not authorize live or paper trading.
